items.source:
Performs automatic serialization/deserialization between the given objects and the underlying binary data in the
Redis store.
items.translation: 在给定对象与 Redis 存储中的底层二进制数据之间执行自动序列化/反序列化。

items.source:
Note that while the template is generified, it is up to the serializers/deserializers to properly convert the given
Objects to and from binary data.
items.translation: 请注意，虽然该模板是通用的，但具体将给定对象正确转换为二进制数据或从二进制数据反序列化，需由序列化和反序列化器自行实现。

items.source: Unlink the keys from the keyspace. Unlike with ReactiveRedisOperations.delete(Publisher) the actual memory reclaiming here happens asynchronously. This command buffers keys received from Publisher into chunks of 128 keys to delete to reduce the number of issued UNLINK commands.
items.translation: 将 `keys` 与键空间解绑。与ReactiveRedisOperations.delete(Publisher)不同，此处的实际内存回收是异步进行的。该命令会将来自 Publisher 的键缓冲到每组 128 个键的块中，以减少发出的 UNLINK 命令数量。

items.source: Use a Flux to iterate over keys. The resulting Flux acts as a cursor and issues SCAN commands itself as long as the subscriber signals demand.
items.translation: 使用Flux遍历键。生成的Flux充当游标，只要订阅者发出需求信号，它就会自行发出SCAN命令。

items.source: Delete given keys. This command buffers keys received from Publisher into chunks of 128 keys to delete to reduce the number of issued DEL commands.
items.translation: 删除给定的keys。此命令将从Publisher接收的键缓冲到每批 128 个键的块中，以减少发出的DEL命令数量。

items.source: Delete the key if the value at key equals expectedValue. Use ReactiveRedisOperations.delete(Object, Consumer) to customize the delete operation using e.g. a different value comparison strategy.
items.translation: 如果 `key` 处的值等于 `expectedValue`，则删除该键。可使用 ReactiveRedisOperations.delete(Object, Consumer) 自定义删除操作，例如采用不同的值比较策略。

items.source: Executes the given action within a Redis session using the same ReactiveRedisConnection. Application exceptions thrown by the action object get propagated to the caller (can only be unchecked) whenever possible. Redis exceptions are transformed into appropriate DAO ones. Allows for returning a result object, that is a domain object or a collection of domain objects. Performs automatic serialization/deserialization for the given objects to and from binary data suitable for the Redis storage. Note: Callback code is not supposed to handle transactions itself! Use an appropriate transaction manager. Generally, callback code must not touch any Connection lifecycle methods, like close, to let the template do its work.
items.translation: 在相同的 ReactiveRedisConnection Redis 会话内执行给定的操作。操作对象抛出的应用程序异常尽可能传播给调用者（只能是未检查异常）。Redis 异常被转换为相应的 DAO 异常。允许返回结果对象，即域对象或域对象的集合。针对给定对象执行自动的序列化/反序列化，将其与适合 Redis 存储的二进制数据进行转换。注意：回调代码不应自行处理事务！请使用适当的事务管理器。通常，回调代码不得调用任何连接生命周期方法（如 close），以便模板能够正常工作。

propagated to the caller (can only be unchecked) whenever possible. Redis exceptions are transformed into
appropriate DAO ones. Allows for returning a result object, that is a domain object or a collection of domain
objects. Performs automatic serialization/deserialization for the given objects to and from binary data suitable
for the Redis storage. Note: Callback code is not supposed to handle transactions itself! Use an appropriate
transaction manager. Generally, callback code must not touch any Connection lifecycle methods, like close, to let
the template do its work.
items.translation: 在 Redis 连接中执行给定的操作。操作对象抛出的应用程序异常尽可能传播给调用者（仅限 unchecked 异常）。Redis 异常被转换为适当的 DAO 异常。允许返回结果对象，即域对象或域对象的集合。对给定对象执行自动的序列化/反序列化，将其转换为适合 Redis 存储的二进制数据。注意：回调代码不应自行处理事务！请使用适当的事务管理器。通常，回调代码不应调用任何连接生命周期方法（如 close），以便模板能够正常工作。

be pipelined. Note the results of the pipeline are discarded (making it suitable for write-only scenarios).
